connector.name: DBHub
connector.registryDescription: Minimal, token-efficient Database MCP Server for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, MariaDB
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dbhub. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bytebase account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
